item.title: Olympic Medical Center board to conduct candidate interviews
item.description: PORT ANGELES — The Olympic Medical Center board of commissioners will interview seven candidates at 1 p.m. Wednesday to fill a vacant seat created by the death of longtime board member John Nutter.

item.title: Film screening to raise funds for Port Angeles Food Bank
item.description: PORT ANGELES — Zoe Omega and Sarah Tucker Zone will host a screening of “The Cocoanuts” at 7 p.m. Friday.

item.title: Tickets on sale for annual Peninsula College athletics fundraiser
item.description: PORT ANGELES — Tickets are on sale for Pirate Casino Night, which is set for 5:30 p.m. Friday.

item.title: Nat Geo Live series set Thursday at Field Hall
item.description: PORT ANGELES — Robbie Shone will present Adventures in Caving at 7 p.m. Thursday as part of the Nat Geo Live series in the Donna M. Morris Auditorium at Field Arts &Events Hall, 201 W. Front St., Port Angeles.

item.title: Candlelight Concert series to host Lee-Alison Sibley
item.description: PORT TOWNSEND — Lee-Alison Sibley will present “For the Birds” during the Candlelight Concert series at 7 p.m. Thursday.

item.title: One injured in head-on collision east of Sequim
item.description: SEQUIM — One person was transported to a hospital following a head-on collision on U.S. Highway 101 just west of Happy Valley Road.

item.title: AREA SPORTS BRIEFS: Olympic Pickleball Tournament results and Sequim soccer registration
item.description: PORT ANGELES — The Olympic Pickleball Tournament was held Saturday and Sunday at Roosevelt Elementary School in Port Angeles.

item.title: PREP WRESTLING: Forks duo of Jade Blair and Ken Daman make history
item.description: FORKS — Forks has had a lot of state wrestling champions in its history, but Ken Daman and Jade Blair made history this weekend in more ways than one for the Spartans.
